title: Josephine Baker, Stockholm and a singer in Europe
summary: Josephine Baker came to see him; he played a three-band event in Stockholm; an expatriate singer wrote to him.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Don't you remember the singer you met over there?... He met Josephine Baker too.
She came to see me.
Was this in 1962 we're talking about?
'58 you say you met Josephine Baker... It's another colored singer lives in Europe. She's very famous.
You were also in Sweden. You were in Stockholm... Was it a concert in a park there?
We had three bands.
Was it open air?
No, it was just in a building. I don't know the name of it.
Was it a place that had a band on one side of it and then had a band on the other? It was like a dance hall?
Yeah.
And it was upstairs or something like that?
I think it was on the first or second floor.
What three bands?
I don't know. Played with this band a night, this one the next one, didn't make no difference, 'cause everyone of them played.
..... a colored singer.
Was she a jazz singer?
She's been over there quite a while.
Do you know the type of music she was singing? Do you have any material from his European trips?
Her name sounds like Nolan. She used to be in America. She was an American singer once and she used to write him. It looked like it was Noltin or...
When was the first time you went to Europe? '58?
You got his passport there.
I've been back about 4 times since then.
That was the first time you'd ever been to Europe?
When he went with Sam Price on the ship.
